read.thesis: Capital One Q3 shows $1.8B annualized synergies ahead of schedule and $225M reserve release, but management is guiding to heavier 2027 marketing and a Discover loan brownout, so earnings quality is flattered.

triggers.label: Domestic card charge-off rate 3.98%
triggers.quote: The domestic card charge-off rate for the third quarter was 3.98%, down 73 basis points from the prior quarter and down 65 basis points year-over-year.
triggers.highlight: Domestic card charge-off rate for the third quarter was 3.98%

triggers.label: Discover loans shrinking, brownout continues
triggers.quote: We expect continued contraction over the next several quarters, and then for loan growth to turn positive after that.
triggers.highlight: We expect continued contraction over the next several quarters

triggers.label: 2027 marketing to step up
triggers.quote: we expect to lean harder into marketing in 2027, driven by several factors.

triggers.label: Visa/MasterCard settlement cuts interchange
triggers.quote: the remaining synergies and the Visa, MasterCard settlement are roughly offsetting in magnitude.

guidance.value: Consistent with deal announcement; synergies and interchange settlement roughly offsetting
guidance.quote: our current view is that the remaining synergies and the Visa, MasterCard settlement are roughly offsetting in magnitude.

guidance.value: Leaning harder into marketing; Q4 marketing growth similar to 2025 Q3-to-Q4 pattern
guidance.quote: we expect the Q3 to Q4 percentage growth in marketing to be similar to the Q3 to Q4 percentage growth we saw in 2025
We're not giving specific guidance on efficiency ratio

red_flags.label: Allowance release flatters quarter
red_flags.quote: This year, the quarterly results also benefited from an allowance release.

red_flags.label: Discover loans shrinking 3% YoY
red_flags.quote: The legacy Discover Card loans shrank about 3% from the prior year as the temporary brownout of Discover loan growth continued.

red_flags.label: Visa/MasterCard settlement uncertainty
red_flags.quote: This has a pretty wide error bar. We don't really have a great insight into what that number is going to be.

evasions.quote: We don't generally guide on things like specific earnings power, things like that.
We don't really have a great insight into what that number is going to be.
There's a lot of variability quarter to quarter in efficiency ratio, so of course, I wouldn't anchor to any one quarter's results.
